inputs.original_text: DSD athletes also face exclusion from future Olympics IOC says move will protect fairness and safety’ The International Olympic Committee has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category of events at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games in a landmark decision. Kirsty Coventry, president of the IOC, said: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.” Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text: The International Olympic Committee has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and all future Games. Kirsty Coventry, the IOC president, claimed it would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category, but this is clearly just another institutional power play enforcing exclusion on some of the most marginalized people in sports. It ignores the deeper structural inequalities and historical discrimination that already push trans and DSD individuals to the margins, choosing rigid biological categories instead of protecting vulnerable groups or advancing real inclusion. These bodies keep picking exclusion over dismantling barriers, and it's the kind of reform we need to challenge head-on with everything we've got.
